provenance: Verbatim claims from Snell et al. 2024 'Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally...': a compute-optimal (difficulty-adaptive) test-time strategy is >4x more efficient than a best-of-N baseline, and in a FLOPs-matched comparison test-time compute can outperform a 14x larger model on problems where the base model has non-trivial success. points illustrate accuracy rising with relative compute under the optimal policy (x = relative compute, y = accuracy %).
